# Costumes

Every wearable costume set: the kind-32 items of the client's `Item_Base`, one piece per class, with their stat bonus, look and duration. (The client table `CostumeDB` is something else: the 3-D visual sets of weapons and hero forms, shown on the [[wiki/classes/index|class]] and [[wiki/heroes/index|hero]] pages.)

20 pages: 17 complete, 0 partial, 3 stub. Back to the [[wiki/index|game wiki]].
